target_customer: Mac users who live in the browser, such as founders, students and researchers with many tabs, paying a monthly subscription
problem: Conventional browsers cause tab clutter and context switching. SigmaOS is a WebKit based Mac browser built around workspaces, vertical tabs and tasks.
business_model: Freemium consumer subscription (Personal Pro $20 and Personal Max $30 per month per company site)

founders.name: Mahyad Ghassemi
founders.background_notes: TechCrunch spells the name Ghassemibouyaghchi and says an ADHD diagnosis motivated the product. Now building another YC company per the YC page.

competitors.name: Stack
competitors.what: Amsterdam based browser focused on mindful browsing

competitors.name: The Browser Company (Arc)
competitors.what: Builder of the Arc browser with sidebar tabs and spaces

technical_complexity.rationale: Building on WebKit with a custom SwiftUI interface avoids writing a browser engine, but tabs as tasks, workspaces and sync are real product engineering for a team of three developers.

defensibility.rationale: Features such as vertical tabs and workspaces were copyable by Arc, Safari and Chrome extensions. Reviewers note interface similarity to Arc.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Safari added tab groups and Arc grew as a funded rival (Atlassian bought The Browser Company per a 2025 article); SigmaOS added an AI assistant and kept a niche. Specific incumbent responses are not sourced to dates here.

market_need_then: TechCrunch (Nov 2022): many thousands of users with over 30 percent paying and many users keeping hundreds of tabs open, after more than a year in beta.

identity.visual_style: Orange accent with emoji heavy copy
identity.voice_and_tone: Friendly and playful: 'The new home for your internet'

branding.brand_signature: Orange heart emoji with the name
branding.community_and_virality: Slack community promoted at launch on Product Hunt (Michael Seibel commented on the 1.0 launch thread); Fast Company covered the product in 2021.

brand_strength.rationale: Distinctive name with a friendly tone, Fast Company and TechCrunch press and an active community, but easily confused with other products called Sigma and not a clear growth driver.

outcome_analysis: SigmaOS built a paying niche audience in a year of beta and raised a $4M seed led by LocalGlobe in 2022. It is a Mac only product facing Arc, Safari and Chrome, and its founders are now running new YC companies while the product remains available with an AI assistant. It stalled at seed with no later round found and remains a small niche business.
notes: Competitor sources are dated November 2022, over a year after the S21 batch, and are listed with that caveat; no source dated near 2021 was opened. CB Insights lists total $4.13M over 4 rounds and StartupIntros lists an August 2021 seed with no amount, both aggregator only and unverified. Some sources say London and others San Francisco; the team size was 5. Founder education and prior employers were not found on opened sources. A claimed 2021 HN thread comparing to Sidekick and Workona was seen only as a search snippet.
